Attached: 2 images

For the first time, the European Commission has recognised women's health as a distinct policy priority, in the EU Gender Equality Strategy 2026–2030. 

It is a step forward, but the next logical move is a dedicated EU strategy for women's health. EIWH's proposal sets out what that could look like.

Read EC's Gender Equality Strategy: https://shorturl.at/9vKBl
Read EIWH's Proposal: https://shorturl.at/sdOD3
